page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes stand in the right margin, in the order of the text. Printed page number at the head right. Running head at the head centre. Gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: catholicam fidem egregio studio conser-vabat, non aut piacula profiteri, intra palatium congregantur. Illinc epistolam sub Imperatoris nomine emittunt, omni pravitate refertam: eo nimirum consilio, ut si ea aequis auribus populus recepisset, publica authoritate cupita proferrent. Sin aliter fuisset excepta, omnis invidia esset in rege, & ipsa venialis: quia etiam tum catechumenus, sacramentum fidei meri Profcri-to videretur potuisse nescire. Igitur le-Epi-scoporum [?]ctam in Ecclesia epistolam, populus aver-ab Ariia- [?]satur. Dionysius, quia non esset alsenlus, ut. [?]urbe pellitur: statimque ejus in locumHist. tri-part. lib. episcopus subrogatur. Liberius quoque Socr. lib. 2. cap. 17. [?]urbis Romae, & Hilarius Pictavorum a Auxen-tius epist.episcopus, dantur exilio. Rhodanium pus Sig. [?]quoque, & Dofanum antistitem (qui Hofium. Sigo. Tbo. Iofanum Theod. [?]natura lenior, non tam suis viribus, quam Hilarii societate non cesserat[?]). Arrianis Cant.eadem conditio implicuit: cum tamen homines parati eisent Athanasium a communione suspendere, modo ut de fide inter episcopos quaereretur. Sed Arrianis optimum visum, praestantissimos viros a certamine submovere. Ita An Chri. 355.pulsi in exilium, quos supra memoravi-

page.notes: The top right corner shows the page number as "ııı" in old form; read as 151 with doubt. Several marginal notes are cut or blurred (Epi-scoporum, ab Ariia-, Hist. tri-part., Socr. lib. 2, the Hosius/Sigo/Theodoret group), so their readings are doubtful. The word "conser-vabat" and "cesserat" are doubtful. The Dofanum name is doubtful. The page has no catchword. The binding shadow on the left edge is not transcribed.
